title: Connect the Office
source: Versioned setup checklist; dated evidence, not a live health check
nextStep: Test renewal and revoked-access checks for each assistant, then confirm Elsie can read this checklist when John asks her.

steps.label: Custom connector installation option
steps.evidence: Owner created the ChatGPT plugin and reached the Office approval screen (8 Oct 2026).

steps.label: Renewable Office authorization
steps.evidence: Approved external clients are saved: ChatGPT and Claude both read and write Office records through their own working grants (ChatGPT 21 Oct 2026, Claude 3 Nov 2026).

steps.label: Connect and test ChatGPT
steps.evidence: ChatGPT read and wrote saved records on 21 Oct 2026 and saved its own Brain handoff with readback on 31 Oct 2026.

steps.label: Connect and test external Claude
steps.evidence: Claude read saved records, room information and room pictures on 3 Nov 2026, and saves Brain notes that it reads back.

steps.label: Elsie reads the shared checklist
steps.evidence: Elsie reads Office records and room information in signed-in conversations. Reading this checklist on request has not been tested yet.

steps.label: Shared Brain, files and skills for all three assistants
steps.evidence: Claude and ChatGPT both save and read back Brain handoff notes (ChatGPT 31 Oct 2026, Claude 3 Nov 2026). Elsie reads the same notes and her own saved memory.

steps.label: Verify build permissions separately
steps.evidence: Both Office builders ran with spending controls: Codex build 48 and Claude build 25 passed (checked 3 Nov 2026). A passing build is a draft until it is reviewed and merged.

steps.label: Verify mailbox permissions separately
steps.evidence: The daily email sweep read both mailboxes and filed sources on 3 Nov 2026.

steps.label: Verify records, renewal and revocation
steps.evidence: Saved-record reads pass for ChatGPT and Claude. Renewal, signed-out and revoked-access checks have not been run for either assistant.

goal: Persistent Office working access for ChatGPT and Claude: private owner records, shared Brain, files, skills, setup changes and app builds. Elsie coordinates the same records and handoffs. Do not reduce this to a status/checklist connection.
